info.title: PandaDoc Public API v1 (baton-panda-doc surface)
info.description: The subset of the PandaDoc Public API that baton-panda-doc calls. Scope is connector scope: two operations, and only the response fields the connector's structs declare. Shapes are proven by the recorded responses in test/mock_responses/ (accessed 2026-09-22); PandaDoc's reference lives at developers.pandadoc.com.

servers.description: EU region. Selected by swapping .com for .eu on the default base URL, not by a separate config field.

get.description: pkg/client/client.go ListUsers. Paginated by page number: the connector requests `page` and `count`, then decides whether another page exists by comparing `total` against count*page (GetNextPageToken). The API supplies no next-page cursor, so termination is computed entirely client-side from `total`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. The connector sends 1 when its page option is 0.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Page size, capped at 50 (pkg/client/pagination.go ItemsPerPage). The connector clamps anything <= 0 or above 50 to 50.

get.description: pkg/client/client.go ListWorkspaces. Paginated identically to /users, including the same client-side termination from `total`.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Page size, capped at 50 (pkg/client/pagination.go ItemsPerPage). The connector clamps anything <= 0 or above 50 to 50.

ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: PandaDoc API key sent as `Authorization: API-Key <token>`. Note the scheme word is `API-Key`, not `Bearer`, so this is modelled as an apiKey header rather than http/bearer.

Error.description: Error. The connector decodes no error body; uhttp classifies by status code.

UserResponse.description: Paginated members envelope. `total` is the whole-collection count and is the only thing driving pagination.

User.description: Only the fields baton-panda-doc reads. user_id is the user resource ID.

phone_number.description: Null in the recorded fixture. The connector decodes it into a plain string, so a null lands as "".

license.description: License tier, e.g. "Guest". Left unconstrained: the connector treats it as an opaque string and the recorded fixture shows only one value.

workspaces.description: Workspace memberships. NOTE: the Go field carries no json tag, so it binds by Go's case-insensitive field-name match on "workspaces" rather than an explicit tag.

UserWorkspaceMembership.description: A member's role within one workspace. These drive the workspace grants.

role.description: Role name, e.g. "Collaborator" or a custom role name. Not an enum: PandaDoc allows custom roles, and the fixture shows "Custom Role" alongside built-ins.

Workspace.description: Only the fields baton-panda-doc reads. id is the workspace resource ID.

owner.description: Owner's email address, not a user id -- confirmed by the recorded fixture.
